source_text: Pontifex sumit de sanguine et infert intra velamen. Solus Christus intrat vera sancta.
thought_title: Christ alone enters the true holy place
orientation: Origen is explaining the high priest's entry into the holy place on the Day of Atonement as a figure of Christ's unique entry into the true sanctuary.
pass_a_gloss: The high priest takes from the blood and carries it in within the veil. Christ alone enters the true holy things.

choices.why: Glossary requires 'high priest' for pontifex, not 'pontiff' or 'chief priest'.
Glossary requires 'veil' for velamen, not 'covering' or 'screen'.
Neuter plural of sanctus with vera; 'holy things' preserves the plural and the glossary sense of sanctus as holy, set apart for God.

bible_refs.note: Pontifex sumit de sanguine et infert intra velamen

pass_b_english: The high priest takes some of the blood and carries it within the veil (Leviticus 16:15). Christ alone enters the true holy things.

problems.quote: Christ alone enters the true holy things (Hebrews 9:12)
problems.why: Source has no Hebrews citation; English adds biblical reference not in Latin.
problems.fix: Christ alone enters the true holy things.
problems.ruling: Latin 'Solus Christus intrat vera sancta' lacks any citation; English adds '(Hebrews 9:12)' not in source.
